2026-06-08 — Reverie v1.1.0 SHIPPED (stable). #117 WS1+WS2 (CLI agent parity: JSON envelope, surface-aware instructions, AGENTS.md, rvr manifest) merged via PR #118 (+ review-hardening commit). GitHub Release live with 4 binaries.

HOMEBREW: rvr.rb manually bumped to 1.1.0 on the tap (commit 4db6102) — `brew install seabearDEV/reverie/rvr` serves 1.1.0 after `brew update`. SHAs taken from GitHub release asset .digest (canonical). BUT the ROOT CAUSE persists: the Release workflow's "Update Homebrew Tap" job failed because secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN (PAT for seabearDEV/homebrew-reverie) is expired — EVERY future release will fail the tap step until rotated. FIX: mint a PAT with contents:write on the tap, `gh secret set HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN --repo seabearDEV/Reverie`. (Manual tap-update recipe if needed again: regenerate Formula/rvr.rb from the release.yml template with new version + asset digests, PUT via contents API — I have push access as seabearDEV.)

ALSO: purged 36 stale codexCLI tags to free the v1.x namespace (see context.releaseTagNamespace). Issue triage done; #119 = deferred WS3; #13/#43 = theme-candidate.

UNCOMMITTED: .reverie/ has post-release notes (this entry, context.releaseTagNamespace) not yet committed to git.

NEXT: (1) rotate HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN so releases self-serve. (2) smoke the published binary (rvr --version → 1.1.0, MCP probe, --json envelope). (3) commit the .reverie notes.
